entities.summary: Áslaug Arna Sigurbjörnsdóttir is an Icelandic lawyer and politician who has been a member of the Althing for the Reykjavík South constituency since 2016. She also served as the Secretary of the Independence Party from 2015 to 2019. In September 2019, she was named the Minister of Justice. In November 2021, she was named the Minister of Higher Education, Science and Innovation and served until 21 December 2024.
